attempts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished 16:9 landscape concept image for ProjectM's QUEST JOURNAL menu, at least 1920 px wide if possible. A finished in-game UI design proposal, not a moodboard or asset sheet. Input image 1 (character screen) is ONLY a reference for ProjectM palette, elegant compass/diamond motif and stylish modern fantasy identity; do NOT copy its character portrait, equipment slots, large enclosing frame or layout. Input image 2 (quest book screen) is ONLY a reference for the green HD-2D village setting, quest content, blue/ivory/champagne colors, compass and bookmark language; COMPLETELY REIMAGINE its heavy book-window composition.
CORE IDEA: a contemporary airy full-screen quest menu floating over the softly blurred living game world. Like a premium modern anime mobile action RPG's translucent menu, with ProjectM's own identity. Render the same sort of lush green storybook village with a stone footpath and warm timber buildings in the background, softly but noticeably defocused. Buildings and greenery remain recognizable through the UI. A very subtle cool blue atmospheric veil calms the scene, not black dimming, not a foggy opaque wall. All interface text/icons stay razor-sharp. The composition must feel OPEN, elegant and spacious: no huge outer rectangular frame, no fully opaque book/page/panel, no gray dashboard, no giant navy fill, no thick gold borders, no large character illustration.
LAYOUT: safe margins 6 percent. Top-left: a refined small eight-point ivory/champagne compass beside Korean title '모험 기록서', small subtitle 'QUEST JOURNAL'. Top-right: a restrained X close control. Left third: compact quest index with no enclosing box. Heading '진행 중 3'. Three spacious stacked quest rows: selected '뿌리 사이로' with subtitle '메인 · 권장 레벨 6'; second '잊혀진 기록' with subtitle '일일 · 권장 레벨 4'; third '바람의 소식' with subtitle '서브 · 권장 레벨 5'. Only the selected row gets a slim softly translucent blue-navy surface, a muted champagne diamond marker and a precise short edge accent. Other rows are quiet ivory text/icons over the blurred scene. A small footer label '완료한 의뢰' with a subtle down chevron. Avoid rows of repeating framed rectangles.
Right two-thirds: a calm reading area indicated only by a very translucent low-saturation pale mist-blue/blue-ivory wash that melts gently into the blurred world, with very light corner ticks and no enclosing perimeter box. Dark blue ink text on this faint luminous area. Above it, an attached chapter navigation row with exact labels '전체', '메인', '서브', '일일', '튜토리얼'. These should resemble subtle bookmarks emerging from the reading area: selected '메인' is a small navy open-bottom tab with a tiny warm diamond on top, its lower edge disappears into the content, NO horizontal lower border. Inactive categories are lighter understated text/tabs aligned with it, not five standalone closed buttons. All controls belong to their nearby content; avoid random disconnected floating boxes.
Large title '뿌리 사이로'. Below: '메인 퀘스트 · 권장 레벨 6'. Hairline divider with one tiny diamond. Section heading '의뢰 내용' with a tiny compass-star icon, followed by two clean Korean lines '오랜 방황 끝에 숲 속 마을에 도착했다.' and '리베르그로브 아래마을로 향하자.'. Generous whitespace. Section '목표', an elegant small diamond/check marker and objective '아래마을 입구에 도착하기', progress '0 / 1' aligned right. Section '보상', two small beautifully illustrated reward icons, a blue crystal with label '경험치 1,333' and a warm coin with label '골드 300'. Keep rewards compact, not oversized inventory cards. Bottom-right of the reading area: one restrained navy action tag with target icon and exact label '목표 표시', connected to the area's lower alignment. Limited champagne on the active tab, selection marker and main action only. One very faint stylized feather/leaf engraving near the lower-right margin preserves the adventurer-record identity; it is decorative and much smaller/quieter than the information.
STYLE: crisp stylish Korean game typography, strong information hierarchy, sophisticated subtle translucency, refined fantasy graphic accents. Clear navy anchors, ivory information, softly luminous blue mist, warm restrained champagne. No neutral gray UI, no purple neon, no futuristic sci-fi panels, no leather, rolled scroll, binding, stained paper, physical book object or huge cream sheet. No heavy repeated beveled frames, no browser/desktop chrome, no chat, no gameplay HUD obscuring the menu, no debug labels, design annotations, logos or watermarks. Produce exactly one coherent full-screen visual, not multiple options.
attempts.correction_reason: Large right reading area had an enclosing double border and excessive material weight.

attempts.prompt: Refine this concept with ONE focused correction: make the right reading area genuinely lighter and open, rather than a large rectangular glass panel. Preserve the exact overall composition, all Korean text, icons, their positions, the quest list, category navigation, blue selected bookmark, compass title, reward values, primary action button, and the recognizable softly blurred village. Remove the entire enclosing double perimeter around the large RIGHT reading area: no vertical edge lines, no bottom outline, no four big corner ornaments. Keep its internal thin content dividers. Replace the hard-edged milky rectangle with a low-opacity PALE MIST-BLUE tonal wash strongest just behind text, softly feathering into the world around every outer edge, with no visible panel silhouette or uniform rectangular fill. Keep enough local pale contrast for all dark navy Korean text to remain perfectly legible. Slightly increase the world-only blur beneath this area to quiet detail while retaining the village setting. Reduce the large decorative compass watermark and feather engraving to approximately half their size and much fainter contrast, so content clearly dominates. Keep the selected Main bookmark connected naturally to the reading area's subtle top alignment with NO bottom button border. Do not add an outer frame, book, cream parchment, new UI elements or text. Same 16:9 full-screen image, same restrained blue/ivory/champagne palette, same visual identity. This is the final subtle-background-blur direction, not a heavy translucent window.
